# apple_certificates (Data Source)

Lists the certificates that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_certificates" "distribution" {
  certificate_types = ["DISTRIBUTION", "IOS_DISTRIBUTION"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate_types` (Set of String) Certificate types to match. Values: `APPLE_PAY`, `APPLE_PAY_MERCHANT_IDENTITY`, `APPLE_PAY_PSP_IDENTITY`, `APPLE_PAY_RSA`, `DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION`, `DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION_G2`, `DEVELOPER_ID_KEXT`, `DEVELOPER_ID_KEXT_G2`, `DEVELOPMENT`, `DISTRIBUTION`, `IDENTITY_ACCESS`, `IOS_DEVELOPMENT`, `IOS_DISTRIBUTION`, `MAC_APP_DEVELOPMENT`, `MAC_APP_DISTRIBUTION`, `MAC_INSTALLER_DISTRIBUTION`, `PASS_TYPE_ID`, `PASS_TYPE_ID_WITH_NFC`.
- `display_names` (Set of String) Display names to match.
- `merchant_id` (String) Only certificates of this merchant ID.
- `pass_type_id` (String) Only certificates of this pass type ID.
- `serial_numbers` (Set of String) Serial numbers to match, in hexadecimal, in either case.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) The matching certificates, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is activated.
- `certificate_content` (String, Sensitive) The certificate, base64-encoded DER.
- `certificate_type` (String) Certificate type.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the certificate.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the certificate, if it has one.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number, in hexadecimal.
